No certificate is reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Technical compliance reports 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown and is not certification. Continue only existing bounded read-only evidence work; do not retrieve credentials, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct external outreach.
